quarterCashFlowStatus: Quarter cash-flow totals and comparable components in the 10-Q derive in deterministic integer-cent code from six-month minus three-month values. The earnings release separately provides exact quarter operating cash flow (3,092) and capex (213), USD thousands, as independent crosschecks; other quarter categories remain derived. Reconcile all four categories to cash endpoints.

syntheticAssumptions.status: Any generated records, dates, counterparties, and undisclosed component residuals belong to the fictional CodeHarbor demo, not to GitLab reported operations.
generationRules: Keep recognized revenue, receivables, deferred liabilities, and cash receipts distinct.
Keep stock-based compensation noncash and the tax benefit distinct from tax cash payments.
Preserve reported opening and closing receivables and deferred-liability line values as source anchors. Explain reconstructed bridges; never silently replace an endpoint.
Separate short-term investment purchases, maturities, sales, equity financing, and foreign exchange from operating transactions.
Do not claim restricted cash is a verified zero or derive a quarter cash-tax total from the differently scoped disclosures.
